description: Convert any moment in time between formats. Bidirectional Unix epoch ↔ ISO 8601 ↔ RFC 3339 ↔ human-readable. Auto-detects epoch resolution. Accepts strtotime-style natural language ("next monday", "+2 weeks"). Optional timezone for local components.

input.description: Date/time string or Unix epoch as a string. Omit for current time.

name: timestamp
